scope: Prospective synthetic successor informed by terminal v3 development; no real-world or publication claim
primary_metric: 64-step position RMSE in normalized NRI units
numerical_failures: Retain and stop; no seed substitution or test evaluation
cost_failure: Stop before tuning; no automatic reduction of matrix or steps
test_access: Generate only after every selected main fit passes independently replayed adequacy; selection manifest frozen first
primary_inference: Six independent generator blocks per domain; average nested model seeds; exact one-sided paired sign permutation on log error ratios; Holm across two domains
adaptive_decision: All main fits adequate, both domains mean paired gain >=2%, every block positive, both Holm-adjusted p <=0.05
mechanism_decision: Also require mean >=2% benefit over train-mean gate intervention in each domain with every block positive; gate variation is descriptive only
